title: Greece pledges more than $670,000 to support hospitals in East Jerusalem
description: Greece has committed over $670,000 to support Palestinian hospitals in occupied East Jerusalem through the EU's PEGASE program, as announced by the Palestinian Authority. This funding will assist in providing medical services and is part of ongoing European support for healthcare in the region, where specialized treatment is often needed for patients from the West Bank and Gaza.

title: Supreme Court rejects Trump administration push to set aside thousands of California ballots
description: The Supreme Court refused to intervene in a case challenging the legality of mail ballots flagged by the Trump administration as improperly cast by noncitizens, affecting 20,000 ballots in California.

description: The United States plans to facilitate trilateral talks with Ukraine and Russia in Abu Dhabi to discuss peace and security arrangements. The talks aim to address the ongoing conflict before winter.

description: The program’s first stage is complete, with all critical technologies reaching at least TRL 3 and a technology demonstrator targeted for 2030. title: Destinus’ monthly output tops Europe’s pre-war annual cruise missile production
description: Defence startup Destinus says it has built more than 1,750 Ruta cruise missiles in Europe and now produces more cruise missiles in a month than Europe did in a year before Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine.

title: US refutes claims that Iran captured Saildrone USV
description: A U.S. official denied the video shared by Iran purported to show an American Saildrone USV near the Strait of Hormuz in flames.

title: Trump, Putin negotiate release of US Air Force veteran from Russian prison
description: Stephen Hubbard, a retired teacher and U.S. Air Force veteran, was released from Russian custody on Wednesday after spending over four years in prison.

title: Refrigeration cyberattacks highlight risks of connecting industry to the internet
description: Cyberattacks affecting supermarket refrigeration systems on Monday in several European countries – including Belgium, Estonia, Finland, Ireland, Luxembourg, the Netherlands and Sweden – have highlighted the risks of connecting industrial infrastructure to the internet.

title: Trump says deal with Tehran 'could happen' amid 'intensive' talks
description: Tehran on Monday said that the country was holding "intensive" indirect talks with Washington to avoid a fresh round of US attacks on Iran ahead of the US midterm elections this week. Foreign ministry spokesperson Esmaeil Baghaei shared Iranian plans to reopen blockaded energy corridor, the Strait of Hormuz, if the US were to meet its demands.

description: Emergency alert systems in Russia and Ukraine were hit in cyber attacks overnight, with fake warnings of possible nuclear strikes broadcast to users in both countries. title: Uganda withdrawing troops from peacekeeping mission in Somalia
description: In tonight's edition,  Uganda starts drawing down troops just days after the UN ends its political mission in Somalia. Also, upcoming municipal elections in South Africa risk solidifying growing political fragmentation.  And the drought gripping Chad could be the country’s worst in more than 40 years.
